package.name: demo_arm_takeoff
package.description:
Smallest useful PSDK client of the dotFlySim simulator: wait for wrapper telemetry, take control authority, arm, take off, hold, land on request.
Restricted to the /wrapper/psdk_ros2 surface -- the services and topics a real DJI payload application has. It never touches PX4's uORB topics and does not depend on px4_msgs.
